title: Steven L NDE 7890
content: I came home from work really late in the morning around 3 in the morning. I had to get up early that morning because I had to go to the bank and it was a Saturday. I went in got my paycheck cashed then I went to a restaurant and had a wonderful meal. Then I drove back into town on the service street to go to a counseling appointment because I was trying to get my life back together. I came underneath the overpass of the freeway and I was coming to the intersection where the green light was in my favor. I looked and no one was in the intersection. I got probably a quarter of the way into the intersection and I noticed out of my peripheral on my left side this driver was going at a very, very high rate of speed. They later estimated his speed to be about 65 or 75 miles per hour. He impacted the driver’s side of my car and that slid me around the telephone pole probably about 10 to 15 feet away. My car was literally wrapped around the pole. The car I was in had a separate lap belt from the shoulder belt. The lap belt was literally cutting into my body and all I remember after looking at my windshield and seeing it all crashed out was this young man. I don’t know who he was, he was in blue coveralls. He reached through the car, looked and saw that the lap belt was cutting into me. He grabbed onto the lap belt and pulled it away from me, probably about 5 to 6 inches and I know for a fact that lap belt was locked so you couldn’t have done that. He took a knife and he slit the lap belt and removed it. From there, I blacked out again. Next thing I know there is a paramedic sitting in the passenger seat with me talking to me really softly. He told me he was going to put a surgical collar on me and he does. Then he tells me about the jaws of life and how they are going to have to cut the car away from me to get me out of the car. I said, 'okay' and he managed to remove my left arm which was locked in like a death grip on the steering wheel. He placed my hand in my lap and put a sheet over me and he climbed under the sheet with me and he told me that I was going to hear some noise. I heard some loud noise outside the car. The jaws of life were pretty hard and it shook the car. The driver’s door popped open within a few minutes. They laid a backboard in the car and the paramedic says, 'We got blood.' I didn’t know where I was bleeding from or what I was bleeding from. I had a scalp laceration but what I believed was I had blood coming out of my ear. I was literally dying right there. They laid me carefully on the backboard and taped my head to the backboard and then put the backboard on a gurney. They wheeled me probably about 15 feet away to the ambulance. I remember that the backdoors to the ambulance were open. I also remember that it was so bright that I told the paramedics that I needed to close my eyes. He said that I needed to keep my eyes open. I told him that I needed to close my eyes and I closed my eyes and I remember a bump going back into the ambulance and the ambulance disappeared. I remember seeing myself above the ambulance. I saw where the accident was, where the police cars were, where the fire department officials were, the people cleaning up the glass. I even saw where the guy that hit me was, his car. I saw them working on him, getting his road rash on his arm from the airbag and that was it. Next thing I know, it’s like Star Trek in a warp speed kind of thing. I was literally flown, maybe flown is not a good word. I was transported fast into the light. I went into this room that had no dimensions but had a 360 degree movie screen around me. These light bodies came up to me. This one light body came up to me and looked at me and asked me one question 4 times. Throughout this whole entire time I am watching my whole entire life review going on all around me and I’m thinking, 'OK, this is not a good thing. I’m seeing everybody I’m beating up. I’m seeing everybody I’m yelling at, lying to. I’m watching their faces and their faces are morphing into me so I’m lying to myself or I am beating myself up or stealing from myself.' This light being is asking me these 4 questions and the questions are, 'Who are you?' I told the person who I was. I told them straight out who I was. I’m Steven. The light being shook their head and asked me again, 'Who are you?' I had went into the light angry and I was pissed that I died. I felt I had more stuff to do on the earth. I was really violently angry so I told the light body this. I said, 'Don’t you (censored) know who I am?' I told him who I was again. He went, 'Who are you?' I’m saying he but I don’t know if it was a he or she. I’m watching my whole life flash before my eyes and it’s starting to sink in who I am. I tried to tell him what job I did. The light being asked me for the fourth time, 'Who are you?' I finally said the most intelligent thing in the world. I said, 'I don’t know. I don’t know who I am.' The light being nodded its head and it said, 'You are love. That’s all you are. You are nothing more than love.' The anger that I had washed completely away from me. I looked at my life image and I judged myself as not worthy to be there. I asked and I said, 'I’d like to stay.' They said, 'Maybe another time, but not now. You have a mission to do on the Earth and you must do it. No one else can do it but you.' I thought about it and I said, 'Ok. I’ll do it.' My mission is basically to share my story down here on the Earth, to tell everybody that they are love too. I told the light body that I would do my mission. It said, 'We will be in touch once more.' Next thing I know I’m feeling cold metal on my back and I thought that was an odd feeling. Then I heard this man’s voice on my right side where most of the damage to my body was and he said, 'Ok, you’re back with us. You’re going to hear some noise. Don’t worry, you’re safe.' Then I heard this 'SHOOP' sound going through my head. And what I found out was they were stapling my scalp back together. I spent about 8 hours in the trauma room, at least my body did. I would say I spent about 2 and a half hours in the light. My whole life before and my whole life now are totally different. In 2011, I was meditating one time and I heard this voice in my head say Hello. I thought I was going crazy. I was going to call a psychiatrist and tell him to please put me on some medicine. This voice came into my head and said, 'Hello. It is time. Your mission is now.' And then I remembered. I remembered everything that happened with the accident. I remembered what I needed to do. And I have literally been sharing this with whoever will hear me.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Described as being transported rapidly like 'Star Trek in a warp speed kind of thing.'

arrival.other_being_detail: Described 'light bodies' and one 'light body' that questioned him repeatedly.

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'room that had no dimensions' with a '360 degree movie screen' around him.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: To share his story and tell people 'that they are love too.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Motor vehicle collision at an intersection; his car was wrapped around a telephone pole.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: A repeated question by a light being: 'Who are you?' and a message: 'You are love.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE above the ambulance, then rapid transport into light, then a dimensionless room with a 360-degree life review while communicating with light beings, then told to return for a mission.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: The question 'Who are you?' was asked four times during the life review.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Life review was occurring 'all around' while the light being questioned him.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Dimensionless room with a '360 degree movie screen' life review; later (2011) heard an inner voice: 'Hello. It is time. Your mission is now.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Who are you?” … “You are love. That’s all you are. You are nothing more than love.” / “Maybe another time, but not now. You have a mission to do on the Earth and you must do it. No one else can do it but you.” / “We will be in touch once more.” / “Hello. It is time. Your mission is now.”
